instructions: Place the base part on the work surface.
title: Start with the Main body shell

instructions: Top plate: bottom to the top of the Main body shell (fixed); Bottom plate (base): top to the bottom of the Main body shell (fixed); Left rubber grip panel: back to the front of the Main body shell (fixed); Lens barrel (right-offset): back to the front of the Main body shell (fixed); Viewfinder bezel (top-right): back to the front of the Main body shell (fixed); Rear screen panel: front to the back of the Main body shell (fixed); Right-side port door: left to the right of the Main body shell (hinged).
title: Attach Top plate, Bottom plate (base), Left rubber grip panel and 4 more to the Main body shell

instructions: Front lens element: back to the front of the Lens barrel (right-offset) (fixed).
title: Attach Front lens element to the Lens barrel (right-offset)

instructions: Left top dial (primary): bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Right top dial (secondary): bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top hot shoe (ISO-518 style): bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed).
title: Attach Left top dial (primary), Right top dial (secondary), Top hot shoe (ISO-518 style) to the Top plate

instructions: Viewfinder glass: back to the front of the Viewfinder bezel (top-right) (fixed).
title: Attach Viewfinder glass to the Viewfinder bezel (top-right)
